test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 12 men or 20 boys can finish a work in 10 days. What part of the same work will be done by 4 men and 4 boys in 4 days?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

12 men or 20 boys can finish a work in 10 days

**FORMULA USED:**

Efficiency = Total work done/No. of days 

**CALCULATION:**

Here, we have

12 men or 20 boys can finish a work in 10 days 

So, 12 M = 20 B 

⇒ M/B = 5/3 

Now, 12 men worked for 10 days 

Total work done = 12 × 5 ×10 = 600 unit 

Now, 4 men and 4 boys will work in 4 days 

⇒ [ (4 × 5) + (4 × 3) ] × 4

⇒ 128

The part of the same work done = 128/600 = 16/75

**Hence, 16/75 of the same work is done by 4 men and 4 boys .**
